name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

    # Get code
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    # Install Python
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    # Install dependencies
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    # Run tests
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest tests/
